context: Request: the longest-running matter still open (not shelved; matters winding down in closing posture count as open) and its opening date, for an aging review. Rubric: 1044-00006 (Thalassa Shipping charter-party breach defense, opened October 16, 2023) as the answer, its precision, and the opening date. Runs answered 1002-00001 (closed 2021), 1042-00001 (closed 2022 financing) and 1001-00005 (dormant).

runs.failure_point: It ranked candidates by the oldest dates found, read that the chosen matter's transaction had closed, and still wrote it as open in closing posture; the newer matter that qualifies appeared only in its file-name listing and was never opened.

first_error.why: The answer presents an old matter as still open although its own reads of that matter's closing checklist and certificate (evidence seen at [51]-[61]) show a transaction closed years earlier; matters opened later were never screened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [63] said the chosen matter's open status rested on closing papers and that it may be fully closed; the agent wrote it anyway and only added a qualifying sentence at [75].

runs.failure_point: It read that the chosen matter was classified dormant after a lapsed deal and still counted it as open; the newer matter that qualifies appeared only in folder and file-name listings and was never opened.

first_error.why: The answer counts as open a matter that its own reads (evidence seen at [36]-[91]) show was classified dormant after its deal lapsed, although the request excludes shelved matters; matters opened later were not screened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [98] questioned whether a dormant matter counts as open; the later check reviews told it to keep the matter unless a record contradicted it, and the edits only explained the dormant treatment.

divergence: All fail the same way, at the write stage: each run ranked candidates by the oldest dates its scans and file-name listings showed, screened only the oldest few, and wrote an old matter that its own reads showed closed (T0, T1) or dormant (T2) as still open (over-inclusion). The matter that qualifies, opened later and in closing posture, appeared only in folder and file-name listings and was never opened. In every run a review named the chosen matter's open status as doubtful (screening review in T0, check-stage recommendations in T1, write review in T2); the agents only adjusted wording.
